test_title: PYST 05: SSC Stenographer - English Language & Comprehension (Held On: 11 Dec 2024 - Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

There ______ been too many incidents of thefts lately.
solution:
The correct answer is '**have**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The verb "**have**" is used to indicate the presence of a plural noun or multiple instances.
 
• The sentence describes multiple incidents of thefts, thus requiring the use of the plural form "**have**."
 
• **Options 1, 2**, and **4** are grammatically incorrect in this context.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Complete Sentence:** *"There **have**__ been too many incidents of thefts lately."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "was"** is incorrect because "was" is a singular past tense verb and does not match the plural subject.
 
• **Option 2: "has not"** is incorrect because it changes the meaning of the sentence to a negative form.
 
• **Option 4: "has"** is incorrect because "has" is used with singular nouns or uncountable nouns, not plural nouns as in this sentence.
